question.text: Which three categories of entities are eligible to act as Depository Participants (DPs) in India, subject to prescribed conditions?

answer.text: Banks, Financial Institutions, and body corporates engaged in providing financial services
Stock brokers, Merchant bankers, and Mutual funds
Banks, Insurance companies, and Foreign Portfolio Investors
Clearing corporations, Custodians, and Credit rating agencies

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists three categories of entities that can become Depository Participants, subject to fulfilment of prescribed conditions: (1) Banks, (2) Financial Institutions, and (3) body corporates engaged in providing financial services. The Trap: "Stock brokers, Merchant bankers, and Mutual funds" is tempting because some stock brokers do offer DP services, but they do so by qualifying as body corporates providing financial services, not as a separately enumerated DP eligibility category. Note: The workbook frames DP eligibility as the three listed categories plus the requirement that prescribed conditions are fulfilled. Specific eligibility detail (such as net worth thresholds or infrastructure requirements) should only be cited from a direct source.
